gap_pcm_real.text: Morning o. Naso I wake this morning see say POS wey i no use commot 50k for my account!
gap_pcm_real.en: Good morning. I woke up this morning and saw that ₦50,000 left my account through a POS I never used.

gap_yo_real.text: Ẹ káàrọ̀ o. Mo ra fóònù yìí ní ilé ìtajà yin ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá, ṣùgbọ́n kò ṣiṣẹ́ mọ́.
gap_yo_real.en: Good morning. I bought this phone from your shop last week, but it stopped working.

gap_pcm_ai.text: Morning o. Naso I wake this morning see say POS wey i no use commot 50k for my account!
gap_pcm_ai.en: Good morning. I woke up this morning and saw that ₦50,000 left my account through a POS I never used.

scene_bank_05.text: Sharp! Thank you. You don save me plenty wahala today.
scene_bank_05.en: Nice. Thank you. You’ve saved me from a lot of stress today.

scene_bank_03.text: Abeg sharp-sharp. I need my money back today-today!
scene_bank_03.en: Please don’t waste time. I need my money back today.

scene_bank_01.text: Morning o. Naso I wake this morning see say POS wey i no use commot 50k for my account!
scene_bank_01.en: I woke up and saw ₦50,000 leave my account through a POS I never used.

scene_bank_02.text: Ah, we dey sorry sir. Abeg dey calm, make I quick check your account.
scene_bank_02.en: I am so sorry. Please stay calm, let me check your account right now.

scene_bank_04.text: Oga, I dey see three unauthorized transaction. I go block am now, make I run your refund.
scene_bank_04.en: Sir, I can see three unauthorized transactions. I’ll block the card and start the refund.

scene_mkt_05.text: One thousand three hundred! Last last, I no get change.
scene_mkt_05.en: ₦1,300, final offer. I don’t have change.

scene_mkt_04.text: Ehn! You don turn market woman like me? Give me one thousand five hundred, na final price be dat o!
scene_mkt_04.en: You’ve become a market woman like me! ₦1,500, that's the final price.

scene_mkt_03.text: Ah, e too much o! Take one thousand two hundred, make i dey go.
scene_mkt_03.en: That’s too much. Take ₦1,200 and let me go.

scene_mkt_02.text: My friend, dis one na fresh from farm dis morning. Give me one thousand eight hundred.
scene_mkt_02.en: These are fresh from the farm this morning. Give me ₦1,800.

scene_mkt_01.text: Madam, how much for dis basket of tomato? Abeg, no talk say na two thousand naira o!
scene_mkt_01.en: Ma’am, how much for this basket? Please don’t say ₦2,000.

scene_mkt_06.text: Okay, come collect am. Ah! You be strong customer o.
scene_mkt_06.en: Okay, take it. You’re a tough negotiator.
